title: CLO Tips Workshop - How to Make Hook and Loop Fasteners
description: CLO teaches you a quick tip in minutes — make a versatile Velcro strip using fabric pieces in two minutes. Follow along and practice now!
transcript:
How to Make a Magic Sticker  
Now, let's create the magic sticker details for this jacket.  
Next, let's introduce the method of using the board to display this detail.  
Sew the magic sticker onto the costume in the form of a board.  
To showcase the material of the magic sticker,  
you need to apply a new fabric onto the magic sticker board.  
Add the fabric to the pattern that we have processed into four consecutive patterns.  
Apply the fabric texture of the magic sticker here.  
Automatically generate the corresponding hairline sticker,  
and adjust the intensity of the hairline as needed.  
Change the physical property to hard and sticky.  
Adjust the fabric thickness as required.  
You can also increase the fabric thickness to emphasize the thickness of the magic sticker.  
So, our magic sticker fabric details are ready.  
Next, we create the magic sticker face details.  
First,  
let's make the magic sticker face details.  
Then we can copy the fabric of the magic sticker.  
By modifying the pattern,  
we can create the face of the magic sticker.  
Second,  
add the sewing line to the face of the magic sticker.  
After adding the card to the inside,  
open the simulation.  
This helps us quickly arrange the card and stabilize the simulation.  
Finally,  
we can match the other side of the card and duplicate it.  
You can use the sewing line.  
The sleeves are Keiko, and the magic sticker is sewn together.  
The appearance is consistent.  
It can also be fixed without sewing needles.  
So, our magic sticker details are complete.  
Thank you.

chunks.content: # How to Make a Magic Sticker for Garments This document explains the process of creating and applying magic stickers (hook and loop fasteners) on garments, focusing on fabric preparation, pattern modification, sewing details, and simulation techniques used in costume design. ## Creating the Magic Sticker Fabric Detail This section covers preparing the magic sticker fabric detail using pattern manipulation and fabric property adjustments, including texture application and physical property settings. - Start by creating the magic sticker detail for the jacket. - Use a board to represent and display the magic sticker detail on the garment. - Sew the magic sticker onto the costume in the form of this board. - To showcase the magic sticker material, apply a new fabric onto the magic sticker board. - Add this fabric to the pattern, which is processed into four consecutive segments. - Apply the fabric texture specific to the magic sticker. - Automatically generate a corresponding hairline sticker to simulate fine edges or fibers. - Adjust the hairline intensity to achieve the desired visual effect. - Change the physical properties of the fabric to "hard" and "sticky" to simulate the hook and loop fastener's tactile feel. - Adjust fabric thickness as needed, increasing it if necessary to emphasize the magic sticker's thickness visually. At this point, the magic sticker fabric detail is fully prepared and ready for further detailing. ## Creating the Magic Sticker Face Detail This section explains how to create the face (visible side) of the magic sticker by modifying patterns and adding sewing details. - Copy the fabric used for the magic sticker to maintain consistency. - Modify the pattern to create the face detail of the magic sticker. - Add sewing lines along the edges of the magic sticker face to simulate stitching. - Insert a card (a structural element) inside the magic sticker to provide stability. - Use simulation software to arrange the card properly and stabilize the magic sticker structure during movement or fitting. - Match and duplicate the card on the opposite side to ensure symmetry. - Use sewing lines to attach the magic sticker securely. - For example, on a costume with Keiko sleeves, the magic sticker is sewn together for a consistent appearance. - The magic sticker can also be fixed in place without sewing needles, allowing for alternative attachment methods. With these steps, the magic sticker details on both fabric and face are complete, ensuring a realistic and functional fastener on the garment.
